findings.summary: gh_api() (the GitHub GET helper used in the pagination/enumeration loop) has no --max-time or --connect-timeout on its curl call. gitea_api() got an explicit ceiling (--max-time 1800 for POSTs with a body, 60 for bare GETs), but gh_api() was left unbounded. The brief asks to "bound how long any single request can run" for these helpers generally, not just the Gitea side, so a stalled connection to api.github.com (slow-loris stall, hung TLS handshake, network partition mid-response) would hang the whole script forever, defeating the resilience goal for the batch run as a whole.
